newsitem.title: INDIA: Political uncertainty drives down Delhi shares.
newsitem.headline: Political uncertainty drives down Delhi shares.

text.p: Strong selling by foreign institutional investors amid political uncertainty pushed share prices on the Delhi Stock Exchange to a lower close on Wednesday, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index closed 19.90 points lower at 878.68.
"Today's selling was mainly from nervous players who fear the developments on the political front might make the government unstable," said Ashok Arya of brokers S.C. Gupta and Company.

The Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) party, a regional partner in the United Front coalition, announced on Monday that it planned to quit the government. A select panel of alliance leaders is due to meet on Thursday to discuss the proposal.
Traders said foreign institutional investors were the major sellers.
"Resumption of selling by foreign players affected the slide in share prices," said another broker.
State Bank of India ended 13.90 rupees lower at 331.20.
